author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

details: When trying out avatars in most avatar worlds it's very easy to accidentally switch into another avatar when calibrating into the  first one, so disabling interactions when in that state would be so very nice. Even temporarily disabling you being able to interact with triggers would be great too so you don't hit anything by accident.
title: Disable interaction when calibrating into fullbody avatar
